prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Build OpenAI Web Based Application
I am interested in building a web application that allows users to manage and respond to reviews from popular sites like Google, Facebook, Yelp, Trip Advisor, etc. The application should also have the ability to generate AI-powered automated responses to the reviews and provide analysis of their online reviews. I am seeking an experienced developer, with knowledge of OpenAI. I have created a list of tasks that I believe are essential to building this web application correctly: 1. Determine the data sources and integration points: The web application should integrate with various review sites to fetch the reviews and related information. This could be done using APIs provided by these sites. 2. Develop a database schema: The database schema should be designed to store the reviews and related information fetched from the different review sites. 3. Create a user interface: The user interface should be intuitive and easy to navigate, allowing users to view and respond to reviews from one location. This interface should also include visualizations of the current online reputation. 4. Implement the AI algorithm: I would like to use the OpenAI GPT API as the chatbot to generate responses to user queries based on the content of the reviews and the sentiment expressed in them. 5. Develop the backend logic: Develop the backend logic to manage the reviews, store them in the database, and trigger the AI algorithm to generate automated responses. Then send automatic emails to the customer
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by briefly introducing yourself.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, a developer with 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, NLP, and OpenAI API integration.

I’d be glad to help build your review management web application. I can work on the backend logic for fetching and storing reviews, designing a clean database schema, and connecting review sources through available APIs. I can also implement AI-powered response generation using OpenAI, along with sentiment-based analysis and review insights. On the frontend side, I can help shape an intuitive interface for managing reviews from one place and displaying reputation visualizations. My experience with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, and pandas fits well with the AI and analytics parts of this project.

What platforms do you want to prioritize first for integration: Google, Facebook, Yelp, or Trip Advisor?
